export declare const MATERIAL_ORIGIN_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const MATERIAL_RECENT_KEEP = 20;

export declare const MATERIAL_RECENT_RECORD_MAX = 10;

export declare const MATERIAL_REF_LIMITS: {
    readonly subject_kind: 200;
    readonly subject_id: 16584;
    readonly revision: 1000;
    readonly artifact_id: 200;
    readonly anchor: 200;
};

export declare const MATERIAL_REF_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export interface MaterialOrigin {
    source: "directory" | "import" | "object";
    owner: {
        kind: "plugin" | "system";
        id: string;
        title: string;
    };
    directory?: {
        workspace_id: string;
        display_name: string;
        roles: DirectoryRole[];
    };
    state: "ok" | "changed" | "missing" | "forbidden" | "truncated" | "unreadable";
    note?: string;
}

export type MaterialPin = {
    mode: "current";
    read_revision: string;
} | {
    mode: "fixed";
    version: ArtifactReference;
} | {
    mode: "snapshot";
    version: ArtifactReference;
};

export interface MaterialRange {
    anchor?: string;
    line?: number;
    length?: number;
    page?: number;
}

export interface MaterialRef {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    pin: MaterialPin;
    range?: MaterialRange;
}

export interface RecentMaterial {
    ref: MaterialRef;
    origin: MaterialOrigin;
}
